## D — Ready to Drive
Accuracy scope: Ready to Drive facts use the pinned official PDF and one physical page per fact; original phrasing preserves actor qualifications, exceptions and modal verbs.
The underage OUI passage gives an additional 180 passenger-related suspension days while the later general passage gives 275; both amounts are withheld until official policy resolves their applicability. [A28] [A33]
Dated survey, crash-risk, fatality and social-statistic estimates have no dated primary-study context in the selected pages and remain verification debt rather than present-day learner facts. [A24] [A26] [A27] [A30] [A35]
The illustration totaling $7240 is an example cost breakdown, not an official fine schedule or guaranteed cost; it remains cost/freshness debt. [A35]
The numeric universal low-BAC vision assertion, fixed glare-recovery and night-vision reduction generalizations lack qualifying study context and are withheld. [A28] [A29]
The implied-consent summary describes unrestricted test demands; verify its current legal predicates before teaching that broad wording. [A31]
The breath-alcohol definition mixes percentage language with grams-per-breath-volume units; learner facts retain only the explicit mass-per-volume units. [A31]
Severe tranquilizer interaction mechanisms and the grouping of cocaine as a narcotic require authoritative correction before teaching; functional impairment guidance is retained without that classification. [A33] [A34]
The early blanket underage alcohol-transport statement is qualified by employment and parent-or-guardian exceptions later in the section; accepted transport facts use the exception-bearing page. [A36]
Confidence process: every drafted fact received a same-model source-context check before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Officeholders, telephone numbers and changing administrative details are excluded from stable learner statements. No source attribution is a legal or clinical signoff.

This is an inference for the fixed corpus, not a measured publication cadence; legal and administrative changes still require monitoring.

verification_debt.claim_text: Resolve additional passenger-under-twenty-one suspension: physical page twenty-eight states one hundred eighty days and physical page thirty-three states two hundred seventy-five days. Both numeric enhancement claims are withheld.
Source/date and verify survey prevalence, distraction/crash multipliers, alcohol-related fatality and social-statistic estimates before current learner use.
Verify the illustrative OUI cost breakdown and distinguish it from actual statutory penalties before displaying any estimate.
Verify universal low-BAC vision effects, glare-recovery timing and nighttime vision percentage before learner assertion.
Verify current legal predicates for a demanded alcohol test rather than teaching the handbook’s unrestricted-at-any-time wording.
Resolve percentage-versus-mass-per-breath-volume wording in the BrAC definition before using its percentage terminology.
Correct the cocaine/narcotic grouping and verify severe generalized drug-interaction mechanisms using a current authoritative source.
